finding.rule: the record must carry no pid, title, handle or path of any non-target window
finding.summary: the record carried an identifier of a window unrelated to the observation

repair.tests: a record built from a wait that observed a foreign window is asserted to contain no foreign pid, title, handle or the last_foreground field

replacement.note: the replacement record contains no identifier of any non-target window

statement: The old record is retained as history. Its foreign-window identifier is superseded for privacy and must not be cited or reproduced.

supersedes.leaked_content: the pid and window title of the user's unrelated foreground window; the values are intentionally not reproduced in this correction entry
